title: Claude Plugin Hook Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating hooks.json configuration files in Claude Code plugins

UserPromptSubmit.description: Hooks triggered when user submits a prompt

PostToolUse.description: Hooks triggered after a tool is used

PreToolUse.description: Hooks triggered before a tool is used

Stop.description: Hooks triggered when a session or sub-agent stops

SessionStart.description: Hooks triggered when a new session starts

SessionEnd.description: Hooks triggered when a session ends

PostToolUseFailure.description: Hooks triggered after a tool call fails (e.g. capture errors to lessons-learned)

SubagentStart.description: Hooks triggered when a subagent is spawned

SubagentStop.description: Hooks triggered when a subagent completes or is stopped (e.g. telemetry capture)

Notification.description: Hooks triggered when Claude emits a user-facing notification

description.description: Human-readable description of what the hook does

type.description: Hook type: 'prompt' injects AI instructions, 'command' executes script

matcher.description: Regex pattern for conditional hook triggering (optional for SessionStart/Stop)

prompt.description: Prompt text for 'prompt' type hooks (required if type=prompt)

command.description: Shell command or script path for 'command' type hooks (required if type=command)
